mechanism_narrative: A sustained 4-month decline in the GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines below its 12-month moving average for 4 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals accelerating supply-side activity, which historically precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises above its 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above its 12-month moving average signals a tightening monetary cycle, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher discount rates and lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises above its 12-month moving average for 2 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above its 12-month moving average signals weakening labor market conditions, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises above its 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening residential construction activity, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines below its 12-month moving average for 2 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month rise in the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above its 12-month moving average signals an accelerating inflation cycle, which historically precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL rises above its 12-month moving average for 1 month but S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the payrolls index (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average signals accelerating labor market conditions, which historically precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS rises above its 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month rise in the retail sales index (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals accelerating consumer spending, which historically precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If RSAFS rises above its 12-month moving average for 2 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is falsified.
